args.risk: The MAIRA-2 report states 'Surgical clips overlie the right axilla', but the question asks about findings in the 'right lung'. The clips are located in the axillary soft tissues (outside the lung field), not within the lung parenchyma itself. However, in multiple-choice questions of this type, 'in the right lung' is often used loosely to mean 'on the right side of the chest'. I need to confirm if there are any actual instruments *inside* the lung or if the axillary clips are the intended finding for option B.

Issues: Option B is the best available MCQ choice because the finding is right-sided, but the visible radiopaque surgical clip is in the right axillary soft tissues (image left, near the axilla; L marker confirms patient left is image right), not within the right lung parenchyma; no left-sided surgical material is seen. The answer text therefore overstates an intrapulmonary location.
